label: An efficient cause other than its effect that is…, from In ordered efficient causes the first…
meaning: Bridge (#401): the secunda via's strong per se premise (STMT-SECOND-EFFICIENT-CAUSES-CAUSE-ONLY-AS-CAUSED: a cause that is itself caused in some respect causes only as caused) entails its relevant-respect reading (STMT-SECOND-EFFICIENT-CAUSES-CAUSE-AS-CAUSED-IN-RELEVANT-RESPECT: a cause that is caused in a respect relevant to its causing causes as caused). The relevant-respect reading only adds an antecedent. This is the secunda-via counterpart of the prima via's StrongPremisesEntailWeakPremises.
